description: Defines the DnsClient class interface for managing DNS configurations, sessions, and transactions within Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: DnsClient
classes.description: Interface for DNS client managing configuration, sessions, and transactions.

methods.name: CanUseSecureDnsTransactions
methods.description: Checks if secure DNS transactions are permitted.

methods.name: CanUseInsecureDnsTransactions
methods.description: Checks if insecure DNS transactions are permitted.

methods.name: CanQueryAdditionalTypesViaInsecureDns
methods.description: Checks if additional DNS query types are allowed via insecure DNS.

methods.name: SetInsecureEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables insecure DNS transactions and additional types.

methods.name: FallbackFromSecureTransactionPreferred
methods.description: Determines if fallback from secure DNS is preferred.

methods.name: FallbackFromInsecureTransactionPreferred
methods.description: Determines if fallback from insecure DNS is preferred.

methods.name: SetSystemConfig
methods.description: Updates the DNS system configuration.

methods.name: SetConfigOverrides
methods.description: Sets DNS configuration overrides.

methods.name: ReplaceCurrentSession
methods.description: Replaces the current DNS session.

methods.name: GetCurrentSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current DNS session.

methods.name: GetEffectiveConfig
methods.description: Gets the current effective DNS configuration.

methods.name: GetHosts
methods.description: Retrieves DNS hosts information.

methods.name: GetPresetAddrs
methods.description: Gets preset addresses for a given endpoint.

methods.name: GetTransactionFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the DNS transaction factory.

methods.name: GetAddressSorter
methods.description: Gets the address sorter.

methods.name: IncrementInsecureFallbackFailures
methods.description: Increments fallback failure count.

methods.name: ClearInsecureFallbackFailures
methods.description: Clears fallback failure count.

methods.name: GetDnsConfigAsValueForNetLog
methods.description: Serializes DNS config for NetLog.

methods.name: GetSystemConfigForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves system DNS config for testing.

methods.name: GetConfigOverridesForTesting
methods.description: Retrieves DNS config overrides for testing.

methods.name: SetTransactionFactoryForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom DNS transaction factory for testing.
